payload.body_they: {{Name}} notices who actually has power, and official titles matter less to them than who can change the outcome. They pay attention to who controls access, money, information, exceptions, and final decisions. The complication is letting power become too central to the way they measure progress. More authority matters if it changes what they can actually build, fund, protect, end, or make possible. Status without meaningful influence may not give them much of what they were trying to gain.
